*----------------------------------------------------------------------

* CACRD90 READS THE CONTROL TABLE ONCE PER TASK AND MUST NEVER BE

  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CACRD92) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(RUN) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------

*----------------------------------------------------------------------

       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -

       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD04) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD05A) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD05B) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD06W) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD06A) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD06X) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD06B) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD06C) OWNER(CARDADM) -

  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD07) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD08) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD09) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD10) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD90) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBCRD91) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* BILLING PACKAGES
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL01) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL02) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL03) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL04) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL05) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBBIL06) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* REFERENCE DATA PACKAGES
*----------------------------------------------------------------------

  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBREF02) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBREF03) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBREF04) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(RR) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBREF05) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* FEE AND STATEMENT HANDLER PACKAGES
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBFEE01) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBFEE02) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBFEE03) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBSTM01) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(CARDCOLL) MEMBER(CBSTM02) OWNER(CARDADM) -
       QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - ONLINE
*
* THE CICS ATTACHMENT NAMES CARDONLP ON THE DB2CONN.  ONE PLAN FOR
* THE WHOLE REGION.  PKLIST CARRIES BOTH COLLECTIONS BECAUSE THE
* PROGRAMS REACHED THROUGH THE ONLINE DISPATCHER RUN UNDER THE
* DISPATCHING TASK'S PLAN, WHICHEVER COLLECTION THEIR PACKAGE IS IN.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDONLP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*, PRTYCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(NO) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(2048) DEGREE(1) -
       DISCONNECT(EXPLICIT) NODEFER(PREPARE)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - NIGHTLY CYCLE
*
* RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) - THE CYCLE JOBS ARE LONG RUNNING AND RE-USING
* THE PACKAGE ALLOCATIONS ACROSS COMMITS SAVES A LARGE AMOUNT OF
* CATALOG TRAFFIC.
*
* PKLIST INCLUDES PRTYCOLL BECAUSE ONE OF THE STEPS IN THIS CYCLE
* DISPATCHES A TARGET WHOSE PACKAGE IS BOUND INTO THAT COLLECTION AND
* IT EXECUTES UNDER THIS PLAN.  WITHOUT THE ENTRY THE STEP FAILS
* SQLCODE -805 AT THE FIRST SQL IN THE DISPATCHED MODULE.  DO NOT
* REMOVE IT WHEN TIDYING THE PKLIST.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDNITP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*, PRTYCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - BILLING
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDBILP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - WEEKLY REFERENCE REBUILD
*
* VALIDATE(RUN) - THE REBUILD RUNS AGAINST WHATEVER IS THERE, AND HAS
* TO BIND CLEANLY IN THE DR SUBSYSTEM WHERE SOME OBJECTS ARE ABSENT.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(CARDREFP) OWNER(CARDADM) QUALIFIER(CARDSVC) -
       PKLIST(CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(RUN) -
       EXPLAIN(NO) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* REPORT WHAT WAS BOUND
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  RUN PROGRAM(DSNTIAD) PLAN(DSNTIA13) -
      LIB('DSN.RUNLIB.LOAD')
  END

dds.name: SYSIN
dds.inline_text:
SELECT COLLID, NAME, HEX(CONTOKEN), BINDTIME
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSPACKAGE
   WHERE COLLID = 'CARDCOLL'
   ORDER BY NAME;
  SELECT NAME, BOUNDTS, VALID, OPERATIVE
    FROM SYSIBM.SYSPLAN
   WHERE NAME IN ('CARDONLP','CARDNITP','CARDBILP','CARDREFP');

dds.name: SYSTSIN
dds.inline_text:
DSN SYSTEM(DB2P)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* ONLINE PACKAGES
*
* PRKYC01 AND PRKYC03 ARE THE TWO ENTRY POINTS REACHED FROM OUTSIDE
* THE MODULE.  THEY ARE BOUND CURRENTDATA(NO) FOR LOCK AVOIDANCE -
* THEY ONLY READ.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRKYC01) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1) SQLERROR(NOPACKAGE)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRKYC02) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRKYC03) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRKYC04) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRRSK02) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRRSK03) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRRSK04) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRRSK05) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRERR01) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(NO)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* BATCH PACKAGES
*
* PRBRSK1 IS THE BATCH ENTRY POINT.  IT IS BOUND RELEASE(DEALLOCATE)
* LIKE THE REST OF THE BATCH ESTATE, BUT IT ALSO EXECUTES UNDER THE
* CARD NIGHTLY PLAN, WHICH IS WHY PRTYCOLL APPEARS IN THAT PLAN'S
* PKLIST IN BINDCARD.JCL.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRBRSK1) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRBRSK2) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRBRSK3) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRBRSK4) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(UR) -
       CURRENTDATA(NO) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(PRBRSK5) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(CBPRT01) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(CBPRT02A) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(CBPRT02B) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(CBPRT03) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) DEGREE(1)
  BIND PACKAGE(PRTYCOLL) MEMBER(CBPRT04) OWNER(PRTYADM) -
       QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) -
       CURRENTDATA(YES) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) EXPLAIN(YES)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - PARTYRSK ONLINE
*
* PKLIST NAMES BOTH COLLECTIONS.  THE EXPOSURE AGGREGATION READS
* CARDSVC.ACCOUNT UNDER THE LEGACY CROSS DATABASE GRANT ADDED BY
* CR-4471 IN 2017, SO ITS PACKAGE MAY BE ENTERED WHILE THIS PLAN IS
* ALLOCATED.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(PRTYONLP) OWNER(PRTYADM) QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) -
       PKLIST(PRTYCOLL.*, CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(NO) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(COMMIT) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(1024) DEGREE(1) -
       DISCONNECT(EXPLICIT) NODEFER(PREPARE)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
* PLAN - PARTY AND RISK WEEKLY CYCLE
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  BIND PLAN(PARTYWKP) OWNER(PRTYADM) QUALIFIER(PARTYRSK) -
       PKLIST(PRTYCOLL.*, CARDCOLL.*) -
       ACTION(REPLACE) ISOLATION(CS) CURRENTDATA(YES) -
       ACQUIRE(USE) RELEASE(DEALLOCATE) VALIDATE(BIND) -
       EXPLAIN(YES) CACHESIZE(0) DEGREE(1)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------
  RUN PROGRAM(DSNTIAD) PLAN(DSNTIA13) -
      LIB('DSN.RUNLIB.LOAD')
  END

dds.inline_text:
CBPRT03J STEP RESCORE FAILED.

 RESUBMIT WITH RESTART=RESCORE AND PARMS('/RESTART') ON THE RUN CARD.

dds.name: SYSUT1
dds.inline_text:
CBPRT04J STEP RPTAUD FAILED.  NO PACK WAS PRINTED OR ARCHIVED.
 THE JOB IS FULLY RERUNNABLE - IT ONLY READS.  RERUN ONCE.
 IF IT FAILS TWICE CALL PARTY AND RISK ON CALL, PAGER 4471, AND
 TELL COMPLIANCE REPORTING ON EXTENSION 2290 THAT THE MONDAY PACK
 WILL BE LATE.

dds.name: SYSIN
dds.inline_text: REPRO INFILE(INCSD) OUTFILE(OUTCSD)

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* GROUP LIST MAINTENANCE
*
* CARDLIST IS THE APPLICATION GROUP LIST NAMED ON GRPLIST IN THE SIT
* AFTER THE IBM SUPPLIED LISTS.  THE ORDER OF THE ADDS BELOW IS THE
* ORDER THE GROUPS ARE INSTALLED AT AN INITIAL START.
*
* CARDFILE MUST INSTALL BEFORE CARDGRP AND PRTYGRP SO THAT FILES
* WITH OPENTIME(STARTUP) ARE KNOWN BEFORE ANY PROGRAM CAN REFERENCE
* THEM.  PRTYGRP INSTALLS LAST - IT IS THE ONLY GROUP OWNED OUTSIDE
* CARD SYSTEMS AND IS THE ONE MOST OFTEN REINSTALLED ON ITS OWN.
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
  DELETE LIST(CARDLIST)
*
  ADD GROUP(CARDFILE) LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(CARDMAP)  LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(CARDTDQ)  LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(CARDGRP)  LIST(CARDLIST)
  ADD GROUP(PRTYGRP)  LIST(CARDLIST)
*
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* VERIFY - LIST THE GROUP LIST AND CHECK EVERY GROUP RESOLVED
*--------------------------------------------------------------------
  LIST LIST(CARDLIST) OBJECTS

dds.name: SYSIN
dds.inline_text:
EXTRACT GROUP(CARDGRP)  USERPROGRAM(DFH0CBDC) OBJECTS
  EXTRACT GROUP(CARDFILE) USERPROGRAM(DFH0CBDC) OBJECTS
  EXTRACT GROUP(CARDMAP)  USERPROGRAM(DFH0CBDC) OBJECTS
  EXTRACT GROUP(CARDTDQ)  USERPROGRAM(DFH0CBDC) OBJECTS
  EXTRACT GROUP(PRTYGRP)  USERPROGRAM(DFH0CBDC) OBJECTS

dds.name: SYSUT1
dds.inline_text:
CSD APPLY COMPLETE FOR REGION CICSCARD.
INSTALL THE UPDATED GROUPS WITH CEDA OR RESTART THE REGION.
IF THE REGION IS RESTARTED, USE START=AUTO.  AN INITIAL START
DISCARDS THE INTRAPARTITION QUEUE AND THE REFERRED WORK ON IT.
